name: gathering

tools.name: gather
tools.help: Spend a while gathering what this place offers. What you find is down to luck and how picked-over the place is; you'll see it when the time is up. Resting stops early.

minutes.description: how long, within what the place allows; default 30

reason: Gathering as a module: the gather tool wherever a place offers it, a session of real time, and a haul from the place's find table, smaller the more it's been picked over; what's found is remembered where, a shop's goes on account, and the model tells it. Replaces the engine's own gathering.
